title: N120-1 Hi-Viz Yellow

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Nolan N120-1 Hi-Viz Yellow is engineered for seamless transitions between open-face city stops and full-face highway cruising, delivering flip-up versatility for city stops and sealed protection at speed. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing a solid 1686g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~87 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by a glove-friendly Microlock2 (Micrometric Ratchet) retention system for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Crossover flip-up/jet modular with wide visor field and N-Com ready.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Modular chin bar; fits most head shapes but may feel tight on very large heads due to fixed shell size.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Nolan N120-1 Hi-Viz Yellow: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Nolan N120-1 Hi-Viz Yellow: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Nolan N120-1 Hi-Viz Yellow. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Nolan's Modular lineup, the N120-1 Hi-Viz Yellow brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Nolan N120-1 Hi-Viz Yellow represents Nolan's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~87 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Nolan N120-1 Hi-Viz Yellow delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
